name: nightly audit
prompt: Run the nightly audit: `python3 ~/helix/workspace/seam/nightly.py`. Report every line it prints, verbatim and in order. Do not interpret, do not reassure, do not add work. If a prediction scored, say which entry and what the number was, including when it failed. If any line carries a red marker, say so first. A heartbeat line naming a target DOWN is reported, never fixed. If the script errors, report the error and stop.
